title: Mass bound for a current L1-close to a constant n-vector
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ. Let |·| = covectorEuclideanNorm on Λⁿ := Covector (Euclid P) n, let ‖·‖ be the operator norm on Λⁿ and on Λ_n := MultiVector P n = Λⁿ →L[ℝ] ℝ, and ‖·‖ₑ its [0,∞]-valued version. Let X ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), ν' a measure on ℝ^P that is finite on compact sets, τ : ℝ^P → Λ_n ν'-a.e. strongly measurable, ζ₀ ∈ Λ_n, s, B, R ∈ ℝ and G ⊆ ℝ^P. Assume: s ≥ 0 and |ζ₀(α)| ≤ s|α| for every α ∈ Λⁿ; B ≥ 0 and ‖α‖ ≤ B|α| for every α ∈ Λⁿ; X(ω) = ∫ τ(x)(ω̂(x)) dν'(x) for every test form ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(ℝ^P), where ω̂ is its underlying form; and G is open with G ⊆ B̄_R(0) = closedBall 0 R. Then M_G(X) = X.massOn G ≤ ofReal(s)·ν'(G) + ofReal(B)·∫⁻_{B̄_R(0)} ‖τ(x) − ζ₀‖ₑ dν'(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (ν' : Measure (Euclid P)) (τ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (ζ₀ : MultiVector P n) (s B R : ℝ) (G : Set (Euclid P)), (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → ν' K < ∞) → AEStronglyMeasurable τ ν' → 0 ≤ s → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, |ζ₀ α| ≤ s * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → 0 ≤ B → (∀ α : Covector (Euclid P) n, ‖α‖ ≤ B * covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, X ω = ∫ x, τ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂ν') → IsOpen G → G ⊆ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → X.massOn G ≤ ENNReal.ofReal s * ν' G + ENNReal.ofReal B * ∫⁻ x in closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R, ‖τ x - ζ₀‖ₑ ∂ν'
